# clap1 handoff: the clapperboard move

Lane clap1, worktree `D:\UE\wt\clap1`, branch `clap1`, base `f7e415b`. Spec: [CLAP2.md](<[notes]/unreal/megajam-2026/lanes/animref1/CLAP2.md>).

## What was built

One commit per step. Every step passed its tests and printed the reference line from main8 twice.

| Step | Commit | What |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 684eb52 | The board is hidden at rest. A press that freezes plays the clap on the player's clock: rise 50 ms, strike, snap at 150 ms, bounce, slow sink, the gun steps aside and comes back. A press with no charges plays the refused clap (CLAP2 5.1). A press during a clap does nothing until the board breaks. |
| 2 | b321ea1 | The HUD charge count drops on the snap, not on the press (`GetShownCharges`). |
| 3 | 2ad2da0 | The sketch sweeps the room far to near from the snap, then the held parts, through a new `SweepFront` and `SweepBand` in the post-process, MPC_Sketch, M_Glow and M_Halo. |
| 4 | 359b8a2 | The board breaks apart at 650 ms (CLAP2 8). The slate and the arm fly left on the player's clock, and 10 to 14 board chips come from the feel4 chips actor in a real-time mode. Everything shrinks away by 400 ms after the break. |
| 5 | 41ae5ad | The refused clap was built in step 1. Step 5 adds a frame-by-frame crosshair check to its test, with a strip. |

The motion itself is a plain struct, `FSupercutClapMotion` (`Source/Supercut/SupercutClapMotion.h/.cpp`). The character ticks it with real
seconds and acts on the events it returns (snap, jam, explode, hand back). Nothing in it reads the scene's dilated time.
The chips use their own random streams (seed 2000000 + n), never the run's.

| --- | --- | --- |

| ClapStrikeSeconds | 0.1 | 0.02 to 0.5 |
| ClapShiftShare | 0.2 | 0 to 0.4 |
| ClapBoardScale | 1.31 | 0.3 to 2.5 |
| ClapArmOpenDegrees | 45 | 5 to 120 |
| SweepRoomSeconds | 0.45 | 0.1 to 3 |
| SweepHeldSeconds | 0.05 | 0.01 to 0.5 |
| SweepBandShare | 0.1 | 0.01 to 1 |

`SketchInSeconds` is gone: the sketch now comes in with the sweep. `SketchOutSeconds` (0.15) stays, comment reworded.
The snap is at ClapRise + ClapStrike (150 ms). The break is at the snap + SweepRoom + SweepHeld (650 ms).

## C++ project, headless tests and packaging (Floodline core lane)

All verified 12 Nov 2026 on c4 with the Floodline project, unless marked.

- **A folder outside `Content/` is not staged by the packaging settings.**
  `DirectoriesToAlwaysStageAsNonUFS` takes paths under the project's `Content` folder only (docs:
  read in the UAT source, not run; the `RuntimeDependencies` route below is verified). For a
  folder at the project root (`Design/`), add it in a module's `.Build.cs`:
  `RuntimeDependencies.Add("$(ProjectDir)/Design/town/...", StagedFileType.NonUFS);`. The files
  land loose at `<build>\Windows\<Project>\Design\town\`, where `FPaths::ProjectDir()` points in
  a packaged build.
- **The `...` wildcard also stages what you did not mean.** `$(ProjectDir)/Design/...` put
  `.gitattributes` and a Python checker into the build. Name the subfolders.
- **UBT expands the wildcard when it builds its makefile** (docs: read in the UBT source, not
  run). A new file added later is not in the receipt until a `.Build.cs` or source change makes UBT
  rebuild it. Changed contents of a file already listed are staged as usual.
- **The archive folder is never cleaned.** Files staged by an earlier package run stay in
  `-archivedirectory` after the staging rule stops listing them. Check
  `Manifest_NonUFSFiles_Win64.txt` for what the last run staged, and delete the archive folder
  before a submission build.
- **The first headless editor run edits `Config/DefaultEngine.ini`.** It appends a
  `[/Script/AndroidFileServerEditor.AndroidFileServerRuntimeSettings]` block. Commit it once or it
  shows as a change after every run.
- **`UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe` prints nothing to a redirected stdout by default.** Add
  `-stdout -FullStdOutLogOutput`. From PowerShell use `Start-Process -Wait -PassThru
  -RedirectStandardOutput <file>` and read `.ExitCode`.
- **Automation tests from the command line exit 255 on any failure, 0 on success.** The log ends
  with `**** TEST COMPLETE. EXIT CODE: 0 ****` or `-1`. A test needs
  `EAutomationTestFlags_ApplicationContextMask | EAutomationTestFlags::ProductFilter` (or another
  filter flag) to be found by `Automation RunTests <prefix>`.
- **`UE_LOG(..., Fatal, ...)` prints its message on the line after the "Fatal error" header.** A
  search for the log category alone misses it.
- **The packaged `<Project>.exe` at the build root is only a launcher.** It starts the real game,
  `<build>\Windows\<Project>\Binaries\Win64\<Project>.exe`, as a ch

	TSharedRef<FJsonObject> ReadHandFile(const FString& Name)
	{
		const FString Path = FPaths::Combine(FSupercutHandData::Folder(), Name + TEXT(".json"));
		FString Text;
		if (!FFileHelper::LoadFileToString(Text, *Path))
		{
			UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Fatal, TEXT("Missing hand pose file %s (the art lane's poses, copied to Content/Hands/Poses)."), *Path);
		}
		TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Root;
		if (!FJsonSerializer::Deserialize(TJsonReaderFactory<>::Create(Text), Root) || !Root.IsValid())
		{
			UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Fatal, TEXT("Hand pose file %s is not JSON."), *Path);
		}
		return Root.ToSharedRef();
	}

	const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject>& HandObject(const FJsonObject& Parent, const FString& Field, const FString& Where)
	{
		const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject>* Found = nullptr;
		if (!Parent.TryGetObjectField(Field, Found))
		{
			UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Fatal, TEXT("Hand pose data %s has no \"%s\"."), *Where, *Field);
		}
		return *Found;
	}

	TArray<double> HandNumbers(const FJsonObject& Parent, const FString& Field, int32 Count, const FString& Where)
	{
		const TArray<TSharedPtr<FJsonValue>>* Values = nullptr;
		if (!Parent.TryGetArrayField(Field, Values) || Values->Num() != Count)
		{
			UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Fatal, TEXT("Hand pose data %s has no \"%s\" of %d numbers."), *Where, *Field, Count);
		}
		TArray<double> Numbers;
		for (const TSharedPtr<FJsonValue>& Value : *Values)
		{
			Numbers.Add(Value->AsNumber());
		}
		return Numbers;
	}

	/** t and q (or ct and cq) of one bone: Unreal axes and cm, q as (x, y, z, w). */
	FTransform HandTransform(const FJsonObject& Bone, const TCHAR* T, const TCHAR* Q, const FString& Where)
	{
		const TArray<double> Move = HandNumbers(Bone, T, 3, Where);
		const TArray<double> Turn = HandNumbers(Bone, Q, 4, Where);
		return FTransform(FQuat(Turn[0], Turn[1], Turn[2], Turn[3]).GetNormalized(), FVector(Move[0], Move[1], Move[2]));
	}

# Lane gun2: reads the vertex positions of a binary FBX (version 7.4, 32-bit offsets) and the model's
# Lcl Translation / Rotation / Scaling, so the sight points can be found without an editor.
# Usage: python -I fbx_verts.py <file.fbx>   prints the vertex count, raw bounds and the Model transforms.
import struct
import sys
import zlib


def read_props(data, pos, count):
    props = []
    for _ in range(count):
        kind = chr(data[pos]); pos += 1
        if kind in "YCILFD":
            size = {"Y": 2, "C": 1, "I": 4, "L": 8, "F": 4, "D": 8}[kind]
            fmt = {"Y": "<h", "C": "<?", "I": "<i", "L": "<q", "F": "<f", "D": "<d"}[kind]
            props.append(struct.unpack_from(fmt, data, pos)[0]); pos += size
        elif kind in "fdlib":
            length, encoding, clen = struct.unpack_from("<III", data, pos); pos += 12
            raw = data[pos:pos + clen]; pos += clen
            if encoding == 1:
                raw = zlib.decompress(raw)
            fmt = {"f": "f", "d": "d", "l": "q", "i": "i", "b": "?"}[kind]
            props.append(struct.unpack("<%d%s" % (length, fmt), raw))
        elif kind in "SR":
            length = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, pos)[0]; pos += 4
            props.append(data[pos:pos + length]); pos += length
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("unknown property type %r at %d" % (kind, pos))
    return props

def read_node(data, pos):
    end, count, _plen = struct.unpack_from("<III", data, pos)
    if end == 0:
        return None, pos + 13
    name_len = data[pos + 12]
    name = data[pos + 13:pos + 13 + name_len].decode()
    pos = pos + 13 + name_len
    props = read_props(data, pos, count)
    pos += _plen
    children = []
    while pos < end:
        child, pos = read_node(data, pos)
        if child is None:
            break
        children.append(child)
    return (name, props, children), end


def walk(node, depth=0):
    yield node, depth
    for child in node[2]:
        yield from walk(child, depth + 1)


def load(path):
    data = open(path, "rb").read()
    pos = 27
    nodes = []
    while pos < len(data) - 13:
        node, pos = read_node(data, pos)
        if node is None:
            break
        nodes.append(node)
    return nodes


def vertices(path):
    for top in load(path):
        for node, _ in walk(top):
            if node[0] == "Vertices":
                v = node[1][0]
                return [(v[i], v[i + 1], v[i + 2]) for i in range(0, len(v), 3)]
    raise RuntimeError("no Vertices in " + path)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    nodes = load(sys.argv[1])
    v = vertices(sys.argv[1])
    print("vertices", len(v))
    for axis in range(3):
        print("axis", axis, round(min(p[axis] for p in v), 3), round(max(p[axis] for p in v), 3))
    for top in nodes:
        for node, _ in walk(top):
            if node[0] == "P" and node[1] and node[1][0] in (b"Lcl Translation", b"Lcl Rotation", b"Lcl Scaling", b"UnitScaleFactor", b"UpAxis", b"FrontAxis", b"CoordAxis", b"UpAxisSign", b"FrontAxisSign", b"CoordAxisSign"):
                print(node[1][0].decode(), node[1][4:])

# Lane hands2: vertices and triangles of a binary FBX mesh in Unreal axes (the files store Blender's Y, which is
# Unreal's -Y), plus surface samples. Reuses gun2's reader.
import os, sys
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import numpy as np
import fbx_verts as F


def mesh(path):
    v = idx = None
    for top in F.load(path):
        for node, _ in F.walk(top):
            if node[0] == "Vertices" and v is None:
                v = np.array(node[1][0], dtype=float).reshape(-1, 3)
            if node[0] == "PolygonVertexIndex" and idx is None:
                idx = node[1][0]
    v[:, 1] *= -1.0
    tris, poly = [], []
    for i in idx:
        if i < 0:
            poly.append(-i - 1)
            for k in range(1, len(poly) - 1):
                tris.append((poly[0], poly[k], poly[k + 1]))
            poly = []
        else:
            poly.append(i)
    return v, np.array(tris)


def samples(v, tris, step=0.1):
    """Points on every triangle, about `step` cm apart."""
    out = [v]
    a, b, c = v[tris[:, 0]], v[tris[:, 1]], v[tris[:, 2]]
    for t in range(len(tris)):
        e = max(np.linalg.norm(b[t] - a[t]), np.linalg.norm(c[t] - a[t]), np.linalg.norm(c[t] - b[t]))
        n = int(e / step) + 1
        if n < 2:
            continue
        u, w = np.meshgrid(np.arange(n + 1), np.arange(n + 1))
        m = (u + w) <= n
        u, w = u[m] / n, w[m] / n
        out.append(a[t] + np.outer(u, b[t] - a[t]) + np.outer(w, c[t] - a[t]))
    return np.vstack(out)
EOF

#!/bin/bash

rc=$?
echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) end $verb rc=$rc"
exit $rc
EOF

def bone_w(arm, name, tail=False):
    b = arm.data.bones[name]
    return arm.matrix_world @ (b.tail_local if tail else b.head_local)


def hand_frame(arm, s):
    """Rest hand frame in armature space: wrist W, distal D, radial Rd (towards the thumb side), palm normal Pn."""
    B = arm.data.bones
    W = B["hand." + s].head_local.copy()
    mid = B["f_middle.01." + s].head_local; idx = B["f_index.01." + s].head_local; pin = B["f_pinky.01." + s].head_local
    D = (mid - W).normalized(); Rd = idx - pin; Rd = (Rd - D * Rd.dot(D)).normalized()
    dorsal = D.cross(Rd) if s == "R" else Rd.cross(D)
    return W, D, Rd, -dorsal


def eval_verts(mesh):
    """World positions of the deformed mesh vertices (N x 3 array)."""
    dg = bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get(); dg.update()
    ev = mesh.evaluated_get(dg); me = ev.data
    a = np.empty(len(me.vertices) * 3); me.vertices.foreach_get("co", a); a = a.reshape(-1, 3)
    m = np.array(ev.matrix_world)
    return a @ m[:3, :3].T + m[:3, 3]


def dominant_groups(mesh):
    """For each vertex, the name of the bone with the largest weight."""
    names = {g.index: g.name for g in mesh.vertex_groups}
    out = []
    for v in mesh.data.vertices:
        best = max(v.groups, key=lambda g: g.weight, default=None)
        out.append(names[best.group] if best else None)
    return out

#   python -I section_plot.py <right_grip.json> <SM_HandR_Fab.fbx> <out.png>
import os, sys, json
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
import fbxmesh

L = "[notes]/unreal/megajam-2026/lanes/"
guns = [("old gun (rodin5)", L + "rodin5/out/"), ("new gun (rodin6 fit 0.87)", L + "rodin6/out/fit/")]
bones = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))["bones"]
hv, ht = fbxmesh.mesh(sys.argv[2]); hand = fbxmesh.samples(hv, ht, 0.25)
X0, X1, Z0, Z1, K = -18, 4, -13, 6, 34
W, H = (X1 - X0) * K, (Z1 - Z0) * K
img = Image.new("RGB", (W * 2 + 20, H + 30), "white"); d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
def px(ox, x, z): return (ox + (x - X0) * K, 30 + (Z1 - z) * K)
for i, (title, folder) in enumerate(guns):
    ox = i * (W + 20)
    for g in range(X0, X1 + 1):
        d.line([px(ox, g, Z0), px(ox, g, Z1)], fill=(225, 225, 225) if g % 5 else (170, 170, 170))
    for g in range(Z0, Z1 + 1):
        d.line([px(ox, X0, g), px(ox, X1, g)], fill=(225, 225, 225) if g % 5 else (170, 170, 170))
    d.text((ox + 5, 5), title + "   grid 1 cm, bold lines at multiples of 5 (x -15, -10, -5, 0; z -10, -5, 0, 5)", fill="black")
    h = hand[hand[:, 1] > 0.3]
    for p in h[::3]:
        a = px(ox, p[0], p[2]); d.point(a, fill=(250, 200, 150))
    js = json.load(open(folder + "Revolver.json"))
    for part, colour in (("SM_Revolver_Body", (60, 60, 60)), ("SM_Revolver_Trigger", (220, 30, 30)), ("SM_Revolver_Hammer", (30, 60, 220))):
        v, t = fbxmesh.mesh(folder + part + ".fbx")
        s = fbxmesh.samples(v, t, 0.06) + np.array(js["parts"][part]["offset"])
        s = s[np.abs(s[:, 1]) < 0.4]
        for p in s:
            d.point(px(ox, p[0], p[2]), fill=colour)
    for f in ("f_index", "f_middle", "f_ring", "f_pinky", "thumb"):
        ch = [bones[f + ".0%d.R" % j]["ct"] for j in (1, 2, 3)] + [bones[f + ".03.R_end"]["ct"]]
        d.line([px(ox, p[0], p[2]) for p in ch], fill=(0, 150, 0), width=2)
        for p in ch:
            a = px(ox, p[0], p[2]); d.ellipse([a[0] - 3, a[1] - 3, a[0] + 3, a[1] + 3], fill=(0, 150, 0))
img.save(sys.argv[3])
print("saved", sys.argv[3], img.size)
EOF

def curl(self, finger, obstacles, open_only=False):
        """Set one finger. Angles for the four fingers are anatomical (0 = straight, in line with the hand); the
        thumb's are turns from the file's rest pose. A number is used as given; 'auto' closes the joint until the
        finger from that joint outward first touches an obstacle, then backs off one step."""
        cfg = self.cfg; s = self.s
        fc = cfg["thumb"] if finger == "thumb" else cfg["fingers"][finger]
        ch = A.chain(s, finger); out = []
        step = fc.get("step", 1.0); mx = fc.get("max", [85, 105, 75])
        rest = self.rest[finger]["flex"] if finger != "thumb" else [0, 0, 0]
        def pre_of(j):
            pre = list(fc.get("pre", {}).get(str(j + 1), []))
            if j == 0 and "spread" in fc:
                pre = [["Pn", (fc["spread"] - self.rest[finger]["spread"]) * (-1 if s == "R" else 1)]] + pre
            return pre
        start = fc.get("start", [0, 0, 0])
        for j, bone in enumerate(ch):                                    # fixed joints, and the open start of the others
            want = fc["curl"][j]
            self.set_bone(bone, pre_of(j) + [["flex", (start[j] if want == "auto" else want) - rest[j]]])
        bpy.context.view_layer.update()
        if open_only:
            return None
        for j, bone in enumerate(ch):
            want = fc["curl"][j]; pre = pre_of(j)
            if want != "auto":
                out.append(want); continue
            tris = self.finger_tris(ch[j:])
            a = start[j]; last = a
            if self.collide(tris, obstacles):
                out.append("hit@%s" % a); continue                       # already touching at the start angle
            while a < mx[j]:
                a += step
                self.set_bone(bone, pre + [["flex", a - rest[j]]]); bpy.context.view_layer.update()
                if self.collide(tris, obstacles):
                    break
                last = a
            last -= fc.get("ease", 0.0)
            self.set_bone(bone, pre + [["flex", last - rest[j]]]); bpy.context.view_layer.update()
            out.append(round(last, 1))
        return out

# Design space: cm, X forward, Y LEFT, Z up. Used by bl_hold.py (preview and proof) and bl_export.py.

import r4lib as R, a3 as A


def rot_frame(cfg):
    """Target hand frame in item space: distal D, radial Rd, palm normal Pn (unit vectors)."""
    D0, R0 = Vector(cfg["base"]["D"]).normalized(), Vector(cfg["base"]["Rd"]).normalized()
    f = cfg["frame"]
    M = (Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(f.get("yaw", 0)), 3, "Z") @ Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(f.get("pitch", 0)), 3, "Y")
         @ Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(f.get("roll", 0)), 3, "X"))
    D = M @ D0; Rd = M @ R0
    if "spin" in f:                                   # turn about the palm normal last (the hand turns in its own plane)
        Pn0 = (Rd.cross(D) if cfg["side"] == "R" else D.cross(Rd))
        S = Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(f["spin"]), 3, Pn0)
        D = S @ D; Rd = S @ Rd
    if "tilt" in f:                                   # turn about the distal line (pronation of the whole hand)
        S = Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(f["tilt"]), 3, D)
        Rd = S @ Rd
    Pn = Rd.cross(D) if cfg["side"] == "R" else D.cross(Rd)

# Transforms are written as t (cm), q (x, y, z, w), s.

import json
import os

import unreal

EAL = unreal.EditorAssetLibrary
TOOLS = unreal.AssetToolsHelpers.get_asset_tools()
APE = unreal.AnimPoseExtensions
PROJECT = unreal.Paths.convert_relative_path_to_full(unreal.Paths.project_dir())
PROBE = "/Game/HandsProbe"


def tr(x):
    t, q, s = x.translation, x.rotation, x.scale3d
    return {"t": [t.x, t.y, t.z], "q": [q.x, q.y, q.z, q.w], "s": [s.x, s.y, s.z]}


def dump(pose):
    names = APE.get_bone_names(pose)
    out = {}
    for name in names:
        out[str(name)] = {"local": tr(APE.get_bone_pose(pose, name, unreal.AnimPoseSpaces.LOCAL)),

	else if (Step.Command == TEXT("lookat"))

	}
	else if (Step.Command == TEXT("aim"))
	{
		const int32 EnemyIndex = FMath::RoundToInt(Number(0));
		ASupercutEnemy* Enemy = nullptr;
		for (TActorIterator<ASupercutEnemy> It(GetWorld()); It; ++It)

			if (It->GetIndex() == EnemyIndex && !It->IsDying())
			{
				Enemy = *It;
			}
		}
		if (Enemy)
		{
			LookAt(Enemy->GetChestLocation(), Hero);
			Note = FString::Printf(TEXT(" %s at %s, health %d"), *FString(Enemy->GetKindName()).ToLower(), *Enemy->GetActorLocation().ToCompactString(), Enemy->GetHealth());
		}
		else

			Note = TEXT(" enemy is gone, view unchanged");

		Input.bJump = true;

	else if (Step.Command == TEXT("fire"))
	{
		Input.bFire = true;

94:	float ReloadSeconds = 1.0f;          // Time to reload.
114:	float AutoReloadSeconds = 0.2f;      // The reload starts by itself this long after the last round is fired, on the reload's own clock (real time, frozen or not). A click in that time does nothing. 0 turns it off: the reload waits for a click or the reload key (lane feel5).
#!/bin/bash
# Lane hands2: run one heavy farm step on pc2 after the load check passes (FARM.md "Before a heavy step").
#   bash step.sh <farm verb> [args...]      e.g. bash step.sh build -Jobs 6
F="[notes]/unreal/megajam-2026/farm/farm.sh"
LOGS=/d/UE/wt/hands2_farmlogs
verb=$1; shift
while true; do
  s=$("$F" status pc2 2>&1)
  busy=$(echo "$s" | sed -n 's/^busy_procs=//p'); ram=$(echo "$s" | sed -n 's/^free_ram_gb=\([0-9.]*\).*/\1/p'); cpu=$(echo "$s" | sed -n 's/^cpu_load_pct=\([0-9]*\).*/\1/p')
  if [ "$busy" = "none" ] && awk "BEGIN{exit !($ram >= 6)}" && [ "$cpu" -lt 60 ]; then break; fi
  echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) wait: busy=$busy ram=$ram cpu=$cpu"; sleep 60
done
echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) start $verb $*  (ram=$ram cpu=$cpu)"
"$F" "$verb" pc2 hands2 "$LOGS" "$@" < /dev/null
rc=$?
echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) end $verb rc=$rc"
exit $rc

mkdir -p "[notes]/unreal/megajam-2026/lanes/hands2/tools/py"; cd "[notes]/unreal/megajam-2026/lanes/hands2/tools/py"; cat > probe_skin.py <<'EOF'
# hands2: read back what the editor holds for the hands' skin. Runs in the pc2 mirror:
#   powershell -File run_py.ps1 -Script <this file> -Log <log>
import unreal

def say(*a):
    unreal.log("HANDS2 " + " ".join(str(x) for x in a))

for stem in ("T_Hands_Fab_BC", "T_Hands_Fab_N", "T_Hands_Fab_ORM"):
    t = unreal.load_asset("/Game/Hands/Textures/" + stem)
    props = {}
    for p in ("srgb", "compression_settings", "lod_group", "mip_gen_settings", "never_stream", "virtual_texture_streaming",
              "adjust_brightness", "adjust_brightness_curve", "adjust_saturation", "adjust_vibrance", "adjust_rgb_curve",
              "adjust_hue", "adjust_min_alpha", "adjust_max_alpha", "compression_no_alpha", "max_texture_size", "flip_green_channel"):
        try:
            props[p] = t.get_editor_property(p)
        except Exception as e:
            props[p] = "n/a"
    say(stem, t.blueprint_get_size_x(), t.blueprint_get_size_y(), props)

MEL = unreal.MaterialEditingLibrary
m = unreal.load_asset("/Game/Hands/M_Hands_Fab")
for prop in (unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_BASE_COLOR, unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_NORMAL, unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_ROUGHNESS,
             unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_AMBIENT_OCCLUSION, unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_METALLIC, unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_SPECULAR,
             unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_EMISSIVE_COLOR, unreal.MaterialProperty.MP_SUBSURFACE_COLOR):
    n = MEL.get_material_property_input_node(m, prop)
    if n is None:
        say("material", prop, "none")
    else:
        out = MEL.get_material_property_input_node_output_name(m, prop)
        say("material", prop, n.get_class().get_name(), n.get_editor_property("texture").get_name() if isinstance(n, unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureSample) else "",
            n.get_editor_property("sampler_type") if isinstance(n, unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureSample) else "", "pin", out,
            "coord", n.get_editor_property("const_coordinate") if isinstance(n, unreal.MaterialExpressionTextureSample) else "")
say("material shading", m.get_editor_property("shading_model"), "blend", m.get_editor_property("blend_mode"), "two sided", m.get_editor_property("two_sided"),
    "skeletal", m.get_editor_property("used_with_skeletal_mesh"))

k = unreal.load_asset("/Game/Hands/SKM_Hands_Fab")
for slot in k.get_editor_property("materials"):
    say("mesh slot", slot.get_editor_property("material_slot_name"), slot.get_editor_property("material_interface").get_path_name(),
        "uv", slot.get_editor_property("uv_channel_data"))
try:
    say("mesh uv channels lod0", unreal.SkeletalMeshEditorSubsystem().get_num_verts(k, 0) if False else "", k.get_editor_property("lod_info")[0].get_editor_property("build_settings"))
except Exception as e:
    say("mesh lod info", e)

```
void USkinnedMeshComponent::GetStreamingRenderAssetInfo(FStreamingTextureLevelContext& LevelContext, TArray<FStreamingRenderAssetPrimitiveInfo>& OutStreamingRenderAssets) const
{
	GetStreamingTextureInfoInner(LevelContext, nullptr, StreamingDistanceMultiplier, OutStreamingRenderAssets);

	if (GetSkinnedAsset() && GetSkinnedAsset()->IsStreamable())
	{
		const int32 LocalForcedLodModel = GetForceStreamedLOD();

		// A positive texel factor tells the streaming system the size of the component.
		// 
		// A negative texel factor selects a specific LOD index, starting at -1 for the worst LOD
		const float TexelFactor = LocalForcedLodModel >= 0 ? LocalForcedLodModel - GetSkinnedAsset()->GetLODNum() : Bounds.SphereRadius * 2.f;

		new (OutStreamingRenderAssets) FStreamingRenderAssetPrimitiveInfo(GetSkinnedAsset(), Bounds, TexelFactor, PackedRelativeBox_Identity, false, false);
	}
}

void USkinnedMeshComponent::OnRenderAssetFirstLodChange(const UStreamableRenderAsset* RenderAsset, int32 FirstLodIndex)
{
	if (!IsComponentTickEnabled())
	{
		check(RenderAsset == GetSkinnedAsset());

		if (GetPredictedLODLevel() < FirstLodIndex)
		{
			SetPredictedLODLevel(FirstLodIndex);
			bForceMeshObjectUpdate = true;
			MarkRenderDynamicDataDirty();
		}
	}
}

bool USkinnedMeshComponent::ShouldUpdateBoneVisibility() const
{
	// do not update if it has LeaderPoseComponent
	return !LeaderPoseComponent.IsValid();
}
void USkinnedMeshComponent::RebuildVisibilityArray()
{
	// BoneVisibility needs update if LeaderComponent == nullptr
	// if MaterComponent, it should follow MaterPoseComponent
	if ( ShouldUpdateBoneVisibility())
	{
		// If the BoneVisibilityStates array has a 0 for a parent bone, all children bones are meant to be hidden as well
		// (as the concatenated matrix will have scale 0).  This code propagates explicitly hidden parents to children.

		// On the first read of any cell of BoneVisibilityStates, BVS_HiddenByParent and BVS_Visible are treated as visible.
		return (MaxIndex > 0) ? (MaxIndex + 1) : 0;
	}

	return 0;
}
#endif

const FMeshUVChannelInfo* USkeletalMesh::GetUVChannelData(int32 MaterialIndex) const
{
	if (GetMaterials().IsValidIndex(MaterialIndex))
	{
		ensure(GetMaterials()[MaterialIndex].UVChannelData.bInitialized);
		return &GetMaterials()[MaterialIndex].UVChannelData;
	}

	return nullptr;

def m(p, box):

#!/bin/bash
# Lane hands2: run one heavy farm step on pc2 after the load check passes (FARM.md "Before a heavy step").
#   bash step.sh <farm verb> [args...]      e.g. bash step.sh build -Jobs 6
F="[notes]/unreal/megajam-2026/farm/farm.sh"
LOGS=/d/UE/wt/hands2_farmlogs
verb=$1; shift
while true; do
  s=$("$F" status pc2 2>&1)
  busy=$(echo "$s" | sed -n 's/^busy_procs=//p'); ram=$(echo "$s" | sed -n 's/^free_ram_gb=\([0-9.]*\).*/\1/p'); cpu=$(echo "$s" | sed -n 's/^cpu_load_pct=\([0-9]*\).*/\1/p')
  if [ "$busy" = "none" ] && awk "BEGIN{exit !($ram >= 6)}" && [ "$cpu" -lt 60 ]; then break; fi
  echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) wait: busy=$busy ram=$ram cpu=$cpu"; sleep 60
done
echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) start $verb $*  (ram=$ram cpu=$cpu)"
"$F" "$verb" pc2 hands2 "$LOGS" "$@" < /dev/null
rc=$?
echo "$(date +%H:%M:%S) end $verb rc=$rc"
exit $rc

**Sun 15 Nov 10:46:32 · Tool call: Bash** (Measure skin brightness with a per-hand mask)

```
L=D:/UE/wt/hands2_farmlogs; cat > /d/UE/wt/hands2_fetch/skinmask.py <<'EOF'
import sys, numpy as np
from PIL import Image
# Skin pixels: red above blue by 12+, red above green, red 40+. Left hand x 1060-1300, right hand x 1350-1750, y 760-1080.
for p in sys.argv[1:]:
    a = np.asarray(Image.open(p).convert('RGB')).astype(float)
    out = []
    for name, x0, x1 in (('left', 1060, 1300), ('right', 1350, 1750)):
        c = a[760:1080, x0:x1].reshape(-1, 3)
        k = (c[:,0] > c[:,2] + 12) & (c[:,0] >= c[:,1]) & (c[:,0] > 40)
        px = c[k]; l = 0.2126*px[:,0] + 0.7152*px[:,1] + 0.0722*px[:,2]
        out.append('%s n %d median %.0f p90 %.0f rgb@p90 %s' % (name, k.sum(), np.median(l), np.percentile(l, 90),
                   px[np.abs(l - np.percentile(l, 90)) < 3].mean(0).round(0)))
    print(p.split('/')[-3], p.split('/')[-1], ' | '.join(out))
EOF

	/** The left hand's bones whose heads the clearance check tests: the wrist, the palm, every finger joint and fingertip. */
	TArray<FName> HandsLeftPoints(const USupercutHands& Hands)
	{
		TArray<FName> Points;
		const FReferenceSkeleton& Skeleton = Hands.GetSkinnedAsset()->GetRefSkeleton();
		for (int32 Bone = 0; Bone < Skeleton.GetNum(); ++Bone)
		{
			const FString Name = Skeleton.GetBoneName(Bone).ToString();
			if (Name.EndsWith(TEXT("_L")) || Name.EndsWith(TEXT("_L_end")))
			{
				if (Name.StartsWith(TEXT("hand")) || Name.StartsWith(TEXT("palm")) || Name.StartsWith(TEXT("f_")) || Name.StartsWith(TEXT("thumb")))
				{
					Points.Add(Skeleton.GetBoneName(Bone));
				}
			}
		}
		return Points;
	}

	/** Closed triangle surfaces, in the hands' component space. */
	struct FHandsSurface
	{
		TArray<FVector> A, B, C;

		void Add(const FVector& P0, const FVector& P1, const FVector& P2) { A.Add(P0); B.Add(P1); C.Add(P2); }

		/** Inside a closed surface: an odd number of crossings along a ray. Seven rays vote, so a ray through an edge cannot decide it. */
		bool Inside(const FVector& Point) const
		{
			static const FVector Rays[] = { FVector(0.31, 0.72, 0.62), FVector(-0.83, 0.14, 0.54), FVector(0.12, -0.91, 0.40), FVector(0.57, 0.36, -0.74),
				FVector(-0.44, -0.52, -0.73), FVector(0.95, -0.21, 0.23), FVector(-0.19, 0.88, -0.43) };
			int32 Votes = 0;
			for (const FVector& RayIn : Rays)
			{
				const FVector Ray = RayIn.GetSafeNormal();
				int32 Crossings = 0;
				for (int32 Tri = 0; Tri < A.Num(); ++Tri)
				{
					// Moller-Trumbore.
					const FVector E1 = B[Tri] - A[Tri], E2 = C[Tri] - A[Tri];
					const FVector P = FVector::CrossProduct(Ray, E2);
					const double Det = FVector::DotProduct(E1, P);
					if (FMath::Abs(Det) < 1e-12)
					{
						continue;
					}
					const FVector S = Point - A[Tri];
					const double U = FVector::DotProduct(S, P) / Det;
					const FVector Q = FVector::CrossProduct(S, E1);
					const double V = FVector::DotProduct(Ray, Q) / Det;
					const double T = FVector::DotProduct(E2, Q) / Det;
					Crossings += (U >= 0.0 && V >= 0.0 && U + V <= 1.0 && T > 0.0) ? 1 : 0;
				}
				Votes += Crossings % 2;
			}
			return Votes * 2 > int32(UE_ARRAY_COUNT(Rays));
		}

return Shot;
}

void ASupercutCharacter::StartReload()
{
	const FSupercutTuning& Tuning = FSupercutTuning::Get();
	if (bDead || ReloadLeft > 0.f || Rounds >= Tuning.RevolverRounds)
	{
		return;
	}
	ReloadLeft = Tuning.ReloadSeconds;
	AutoReloadLeft = 0.f;   // the reload key during the wait starts it now
	USupercutAudio::Get(this).PlayFlat(TEXT("rev_reload"));
	UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Display, TEXT("RELOAD start"));
}

void ASupercutCharacter::OnReloadBeat(FName Beat)
{
	// The hands lane keys its poses here. The empties fall from the open cylinder on the eject beat.
	UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Display, TEXT("RELOAD beat %s"), *Beat.ToString());
	if (Beat == TEXT("Eject"))
	{
		DropShells();
	}
}

void ASupercutCharacter::DropShells()
{
	// Six shells, one from each chamber of the open cylinder, where the rounds sit now.
	TArray<FTransform> Shells;
	for (const UStaticMeshComponent* Round : GunRounds)
	{
		Shells.Add(Round->GetComponentTransform());
	}
	ASupercutChips::DropShells(GetWorld(), Shells, GetVelocity(), GunRounds[0]->GetStaticMesh());
}

void ASupercutCharacter::RefillRounds()
{
	Rounds = FSupercutTuning::Get().RevolverRounds;
	ReloadLeft = 0.f;
	AutoReloadLeft = 0.f;
	UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Display, TEXT("RELOAD at once: %d rounds"), Rounds);
}

void ASupercutCharacter::PlaceAt(const FVector& Location, float Yaw)
{
	const FRotator Facing(0.f, Yaw, 0.f);
	GetCharacterMovement()->StopMovementImmediately();
	SetActorLocationAndRotation(Location, Facing, false, nullptr, ETeleportType::ResetPhysics);
	if (AController* Driver = GetController())
	{
		Driver->SetControlRotation(Facing);
	}
	LastControl = GetControlRotation();   // a placement is no turn: the gun does not lag it
	ViewMotion.NoteDraw();
	JumpBuffer = 0.f;
	bTrackingJump = false;
}

bool ASupercutCharacter::HasClappedThisProgramRun()
{
	return bClappedThisProgramRun;

void ASupercutCharacter::ForgetClapForTests()
{
	bClappedThisProgramRun = false;

### view1's reload beats and the hand poses they need

view1 committed its reload as 051c78b on its branch (`view1`, not merged into this one when this was written). Each beat
calls `ASupercutCharacter::OnReloadBeat(FName Beat)` once, at a share of ReloadSeconds (the table `ReloadBeatsAt` in
`SupercutViewMotion.cpp`); today it logs the beat and drops the shells on `Eject`. The hands would key their poses there,
or better, read the reload's share each tick and blend between the beats' poses, since a beat is a moment and a pose
change takes time.

The right hand holds `right_grip` in every beat unless noted. Only `right_grip`, `left_support`, `left_clear` and
`left_board` exist; every other pose below is a list for the art lane, named here only as a suggestion.

| `Seated` (0.658) | a push as the rounds seat; all six show | `right_grip` | presses the rounds home | needs `left_seat` |
| `Away` (0.733) | | `right_grip` | the loading hand comes off the cylinder | can blend toward `left_clear` |

bool FSupercutClapMotionSnapTest::RunTest(const FString& Parameters)
{
	FClapMotionTuningRestore Restore;
	const FSupercutTuning& Tuning = FSupercutTuning::Get();
	TestTrue(TEXT("the snap is 150 ms after the press by default"), FMath::IsNearlyEqual(FSupercutClapMotion::SnapSeconds(Tuning), 0.15f, 1.e-6f));
	for (const float Fps : { 30.f, 60.f, 240.f })
	{
		FClapMotionTestWorld World;
		if (!TestTrue(TEXT("test world starts"), World.Start()))
		{
			return false;
		}
		ASupercutCharacter& Hero = *World.Hero();
		const float Step = 1.f / Fps;
		World.Run(0.3f, Step);
		const float Calm = Hero.GetViewAngle();
		const USupercutAudio& Audio = USupercutAudio::Get(World.GetTestWorld());
		const int32 Mark = Audio.GetAsked().Num();
		TestTrue(TEXT("the clap freezes"), Hero.Clap());
		float SnapClock = -1.f;
		float AngleBefore = 0.f;
		float AngleAt = 0.f;
		int32 SnapsBefore = 0;
		for (int32 Frame = 0; Frame < FMath::CeilToInt(0.4f * Fps) && SnapClock < 0.f; ++Frame)
		{
			AngleBefore = Hero.GetViewAngle();
			SnapsBefore = ClapMotionCountAsked(Audio, Mark, TEXT("clap_snap"));
			World.Run(Step, Step);
			if (Hero.GetClapMotion().HasSnapped())
			{
				SnapClock = Hero.GetClapMotion().GetClock();
				AngleAt = Hero.GetViewAngle();
			}
		}
		AddInfo(FString::Printf(TEXT("%.0f fps: the snap frame ends %.4f s after the press; view angle %.2f before it, %.2f on it (live %.2f)"), Fps, SnapClock, AngleBefore, AngleAt, Calm));
		TestTrue(FString::Printf(TEXT("%.0f fps: the snap lands on the first frame at or past 150 ms"), Fps), SnapClock >= 0.15f - 1.e-4f && SnapClock < 0.15f + Step - 1.e-4f);
		TestEqual(FString::Printf(TEXT("%.0f fps: no clap sound before the snap"), Fps), SnapsBefore, 0);
		TestEqual(FString::Printf(TEXT("%.0f fps: the clap sound on the snap frame"), Fps), ClapMotionCountAsked(Audio, Mark, TEXT("clap_snap")), 1);
		TestTrue(FString::Printf(TEXT("%.0f fps: before the snap only the freeze's narrowing, no punch"), Fps), FMath::IsNearlyEqual(AngleBefore, Calm - Tuning.FreezeFovDrop, 0.01f));
		TestTrue(FString::Printf(TEXT("%.0f fps: the FOV punch on the snap frame"), Fps), AngleAt < Calm - Tuning.FreezeFovDrop - 0.5f * Tuning.FreezeFovPunch);
	}
	return true;
}

}

void FSupercutClapMotion::PoseRest(const FSupercutTuning& Tuning)
{
	// Hidden below the frame, where the next rise starts.
	RootLocation = HiddenKey.Location - FVector(0.f, ShiftCm(Tuning), 0.f);
	RootRoll = HiddenKey.Roll;
	ArmOpen = 1.f;
	PlaceWhole(Tuning);
	bBoardShown = false;
	bHandShown = false;
	GunAsideOffset = FVector::ZeroVector;
	GunAsideRoll = 0.f;
}

void FSupercutClapMotion::PlaceWhole(const FSupercutTuning& Tuning)
{
	RootTransform = FacingEye(RootLocation, RootRoll);
	BoardInRoot = FTransform::Identity;
	// The arm opens about the hinge; drawn mirrored, its roll is + to open.
	ArmInRoot = FTransform(FRotator(0.f, 0.f, Tuning.ClapArmOpenDegrees * ArmOpen), HingeOnBoard(Tuning));
	PieceScale = 1.f;
}

namespace
{
	/** One static mesh's triangles, in the space ToSpace takes the mesh's own space to. */
	FHandsSurface HandsMeshSurface(const UStaticMeshComponent& Mesh, const FTransform& ToSpace)
	{
		FHandsSurface Surface;
		const FMeshDescription* Description = Mesh.GetStaticMesh()->GetMeshDescription(0);
		const TVertexAttributesRef<const FVector3f> Positions = Description->GetVertexPositions();
		for (const FTriangleID Tri : Description->Triangles().GetElementIDs())
		{
			const TArrayView<const FVertexID> Corners = Description->GetTriangleVertices(Tri);
			Surface.Add(ToSpace.TransformPosition(FVector(Positions[Corners[0]])), ToSpace.TransformPosition(FVector(Positions[Corners[1]])), ToSpace.TransformPosition(FVector(Positions[Corners[2]])));
		}
		return Surface;
	}

	/** Every distance along the ray (From, unit Dir) at which it crosses the surface. */
	TArray<double> HandsRayHits(const FHandsSurface& Surface, const FVector& From, const FVector& Dir)
	{
		TArray<double> Hits;
		for (int32 Tri = 0; Tri < Surface.A.Num(); ++Tri)
		{
			double T = 0.0;
			const FVector E1 = Surface.B[Tri] - Surface.A[Tri], E2 = Surface.C[Tri] - Surface.A[Tri];
			const FVector P = FVector::CrossProduct(Dir, E2);
			const double Det = FVector::DotProduct(E1, P);
			if (FMath::Abs(Det) < 1e-12)
			{
				continue;
			}
			const FVector S = From - Surface.A[Tri];
			const double U = FVector::DotProduct(S, P) / Det;
			const FVector Q = FVector::CrossProduct(S, E1);
			const double V = FVector::DotProduct(Dir, Q) / Det;
			T = FVector::DotProduct(E2, Q) / Det;
			if (U >= 0.0 && V >= 0.0 && U + V <= 1.0 && T > 0.0)
			{
				Hits.Add(T);
			}
		}
		return Hits;
	}

#!/bin/bash
# farm.sh: build, test, package and run a SUPERCUT project copy on a farm PC, driven from c4. Details: ../FARM.md.
#
#   farm.sh mirror  <host> <name> <project folder on c4>     copy the project to <root>\Farm\<name> (changed files only)
#   farm.sh build   <host> <name> <log folder> [build.ps1 args, e.g. -Target Supercut -Jobs 8]
#   farm.sh test    <host> <name> <log folder> [run_tests.ps1 args, e.g. -Filter Supercut.Rooms]
#   farm.sh package <host> <name> <log folder>               Tools\package.cmd   -> <root>\Farm\_builds\<name>\Supercut59
#   farm.sh package-shipping <host> <name> <log folder>      Tools\package_shipping.cmd -> ...\_builds\<name>\Supercut59_ship
#   farm.sh run     <host> <name> <log folder> [run_demo.ps1 args]   {P} = the mirror folder there, e.g. -Script {P}\Script\main8.txt
#   farm.sh fetch   <host> <name> <remote path> <local folder>   path in the mirror, or builds/... or out/...
#   farm.sh status  <host>
#
# Each step brings its logs back to <log folder>/<step>/ and exits with the remote step's exit code.
# Logs that come back have the PC's user and computer names replaced by USER and PC.
set -u
here=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)

root_of() {   # one line per farm PC: ssh alias, root folder there (engine in <root>\UE_5.9, mirrors in <root>\Farm)
  case "$1" in
    [pc-b]) echo 'C:\UE' ;;
base.txt
build
run_before_gate
run_before_hall
run_skin055_gate
run_skin055_hall
test

{
 "file_path": "[notes]\\unreal\\megajam-2026\\lanes\\hands2\\tools\\make_shots.py",
 "content": "# Lane hands2: turns a picture run's 1920x1080 PNGs into the lane's JPGs (at most 960 wide), each with its caption\n# (what is wrong in it) written in a band under it.\n#   python -I make_shots.py <gate run shots> <hall run shots> <reference jpg> <captions.json> <out folder>\n# captions.json: {\"<jpg name>\": \"caption\", ...}; every name below must have one.\nimport json\nimport os\nimport sys\nimport textwrap\n\nfrom PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont\n\nGATE, HALL, REFERENCE, CAPTIONS, OUT = sys.argv[1:6]\ncaptions = json.load(open(CAPTIONS, encoding=\"utf-8\"))\nfont = ImageFont.truetype(\"C:/Windows/Fonts/arial.ttf\", 16)\nsmall = ImageFont.truetype(\"C:/Windows/Fonts/arial.ttf\", 13)\n\n\ndef load(folder, name):\n    return Image.open(os.path.join(folder, name + \".png\")).convert(\"RGB\")\n\n\ndef save(image, name):\n    lines = []\n    for paragraph in captions[name].split(\"\\n\"):\n        lines += textwrap.wrap(paragraph, 110) or [\"\"]\n    band = 10 + 20 * len(lines)\n    page = Image.new(\"RGB\", (image.width, image.height + band), (20, 20, 20))\n    page.paste(image, (0, 0))\n    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(page)\n    for row, line in enumerate(lines):\n        draw.text((8, image.height + 5 + 20 * row), line, fill=(235, 235, 235), font=font)\n    page.save(os.path.join(OUT, name + \".jpg\"), quality=88)\n\n\ndef strip(folder, names, labels, columns=3):\n    width = 960 // columns\n    height = width * 9 // 16\n    rows = (len(names) + columns - 1) // columns\n    sheet = Image.new(\"RGB\", (960, rows * height), (0, 0, 0))\n    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)\n    for index, (name, label) in enumerate(zip(names, labels)):\n        x, y = (index % columns) * width, (index // columns) * height\n        sheet.paste(load(folder, name).resize((width, height), Image.LANCZOS), (x, y))\n        draw.rectangle((x, y, x + 64, y + 17), fill=(0, 0, 0))\n        draw.text((x + 3, y + 2), label, fill=(255, 255, 0), font=small)\n    return sheet\n\n\nos.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)\nhalf = (960, 540)\nsave(load(GATE, \"h_rest\").resize(half, Image.LANCZOS), \"hands2_rest\")\nsave(load(GATE, \"h_kick\").resize(half, Image.LANCZOS), \"hands2_kick_peak\")\nsave(load(GATE, \"h_wall\").resize(half, Image.LANCZOS), \"hands2_at_wall\")\nhall = Image.new(\"RGB\", (960, 270))\nhall.paste(load(HALL, \"h_hall_left\").resize((480, 270), Image.LANCZOS), (0, 0))\nhall.paste(load(HALL, \"h_hall_right\").resize((480, 270), Image.LANCZOS), (480, 0))\nsave(hall, \"hands2_dark_hall\")\nclap = [\"c%04d\" % ms for ms in range(0, 951, 50) if os.path.isfile(os.path.join(GATE, \"c%04d.png\" % ms))]\nsave(strip(GATE, clap, [\"%d ms\" % int(name[1:]) for name in clap]), \"hands2_clap_strip\")\nreload = [\"r%04d\" % ms for ms in range(0, 1201, 100) if os.path.isfile(os.path.join(GATE, \"r%04d.png\" % ms))]\nsave(strip(GATE, reload, [\"%d ms\" % int(name[1:]) for name in reload]), \"hands2_reload_strip\")\nreference = Image.open(REFERENCE).convert(\"RGB\")\npair = Image.new(\"RGB\", (960, 270))\npair.paste(load(GATE, \"h_rest\").resize((480, 270), Image.LANCZOS), (0, 0))\npair.paste(reference.crop((0, 0, reference.width // 2, reference.height // 2)).resize((480, 270), Image.LANCZOS), (480, 0))\nsave(pair, \"hands2_rest_beside_before\")\nprint(\"made\", sorted(os.listdir(OUT)))\n"
}

**Sun 15 Nov 13:56:24 · Tool call: Bash** (Write the frame-time script)

```
cd /d/UE/wt/hands2/Script && python -c "
L=['# Lane hands2: frame time, rigged hands on against off. Room fight/01_wind_machine, -Dev (F4: no damage), no fixed step.',
'# Shots, claps, reloads and walking for 30 s, so the hands blend and the gun moves.',
'0.05 key F4','0.20 look 0 0']
t=1.0; i=0
while t<30:
    L.append('%.2f fire'%t)
    if i%4==1: L.append('%.2f clap'%(t+0.4))
    if i%4==3: L.append('%.2f reload'%(t+0.4))
    L.append('%.2f move %d 0'%(t+0.2, 1 if i%2==0 else -1))
    L.append('%.2f move 0 0'%(t+1.0))
    t+=1.5; i+=1
L.append('31.00 end')
open('hands2_perf.txt','wb').write(('\r\n'.join(L)+'\r\n').encode())
"; head -12 hands2_perf.txt | tr -d '\r'; wc -l hands2_perf.txt
```

import json,sys,os
O,W=sys.argv[1:3]
for n in ["index","rest","right_grip","left_support","left_board","left_clear"]:
    a=json.load(open(os.path.join(O,"poses",n+".json"))); b=json.load(open(os.path.join(W,"Content/Hands/Poses",n+".json")))
    def flat(x,p=""):
        if isinstance(x,dict):
            for k,v in x.items(): yield from flat(v,p+"/"+k)
        elif isinstance(x,list):
            for i,v in enumerate(x): yield from flat(v,p+"[%d]"%i)
        else: yield p,x
    fa=dict(flat(a)); fb=dict(flat(b))
    keys=set(fa)|set(fb); diff=[k for k in keys if fa.get(k)!=fb.get(k)]
    num=[abs(fa[k]-fb[k]) for k in diff if isinstance(fa.get(k),(int,float)) and isinstance(fb.get(k),(int,float))]
    other=[k for k in diff if not (isinstance(fa.get(k),(int,float)) and isinstance(fb.get(k),(int,float)))]
    print(n, "keys",len(fa),len(fb),"diff",len(diff),"maxnum %.5f"%max(num) if num else "", "nonnum",other[:5])
print(open(os.path.join(O,"poses/index.json")).read()[:1500])
EOF

# Minimal binary FBX reader: compares the geometry, skin and bind pose arrays of two FBX files.
import struct, zlib, sys
import numpy as np
def read(path):
    d=open(path,'rb').read(); ver=struct.unpack('<I',d[23:27])[0]; big=ver>=7500
    def node(o):
        if big: end,n,pl=struct.unpack('<QQQ',d[o:o+24]); o+=24
        else: end,n,pl=struct.unpack('<III',d[o:o+12]); o+=12
        nl=d[o]; o+=1
        if end==0: return None,o
        name=d[o:o+nl].decode(); o+=nl
        props=[]
        for _ in range(n):
            t=chr(d[o]); o+=1
            if t in 'YCIFDL':
                f={'Y':'<h','C':'<?','I':'<i','F':'<f','D':'<d','L':'<q'}[t]; s=struct.calcsize(f); props.append(struct.unpack(f,d[o:o+s])[0]); o+=s
            elif t in 'fdlib':
                ln,enc,cl=struct.unpack('<III',d[o:o+12]); o+=12; raw=d[o:o+cl]; o+=cl
                if enc: raw=zlib.decompress(raw)
                props.append(np.frombuffer(raw,dtype={'f':'<f4','d':'<f8','l':'<i8','i':'<i4','b':'u1'}[t]))
            elif t in 'SR':
                ln=struct.unpack('<I',d[o:o+4])[0]; o+=4; props.append(d[o:o+ln]); o+=ln
        kids=[]
        while o<end:
            k,o=node(o)
            if k is None: break
            kids.append(k)
        return (name,props,kids),end
    o=27; top=[]
    while o<len(d)-200:
        k,o=node(o)
        if k is None: break
        top.append(k)
    return top
def walk(n,path=""):
    name,props,kids=n; p=path+"/"+name
    yield p,name,props,kids
    for k in kids: yield from walk(k,p)
def arrays(path):
    out={}
    objs=[n for n in read(path) if n[0]=='Objects'][0]
    for obj in objs[2]:
        label=obj[1][1].split(b'\x00')[0].decode(errors='replace') if len(obj[1])>1 else '?'
        for p,name,props,kids in walk(obj):
            for i,v in enumerate(props):
                if isinstance(v,np.ndarray): out[(obj[0],label,p,i)]=v
            if name=='P' and len(props)>4 and isinstance(props[0],bytes) and props[0] in (b'Lcl Translation',b'Lcl Rotation',b'Lcl Scaling'):
                out[(obj[0],label,p+props[0].decode(),0)]=np.array(props[4:],dtype=float)
    return out
a=arrays(sys.argv[1]); b=arrays(sys.argv[2])
print("arrays",len(a),len(b),"only a",[k for k in a if k not in b][:5],"only b",[k for k in b if k not in a][:5])
worst=[]
for k in a:
    if k in b:
        x,y=a[k],b[k]
        if x.shape!=y.shape: print("SHAPE",k,x.shape,y.shape); continue
        dm=float(np.max(np.abs(x.astype(float)-y.astype(float)))) if x.size else 0.0
        worst.append((dm,k))
worst.sort(reverse=True)
for w in worst[:12]: print("%.6g"%w[0], w[1])

	for (const FSupercutHandPose* Pose : { &Data.Rest, &Data.RightGrip, &Data.LeftSupport, &Data.LeftClear, &Data.LeftBoard })
	{
		TArray<FName> Bones;
		Pose->Local.GetKeys(Bones);
		Named.Append(Bones);
	}
	for (const FName& Bone : Named)
	{
		if (GetBoneIndex(Bone) == INDEX_NONE)
		{
			UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Fatal, TEXT("SKM_Hands_Fab has no bone %s, which Content/Hands/Poses names."), *Bone.ToString());
		}
	}

	SetCollisionProfileName(TEXT("NoCollision"));
	SetCanEverAffectNavigation(false);
	SetCastShadow(false);
	BoneSpaceTransforms = Mesh->GetRefSkeleton().GetRefBonePose();
	SetLocals(Data.RightGrip);
	SetLeftBlend(0.f, FTransform::Identity);
}

void USupercutHands::SetLocals(const FSupercutHandPose& Pose)
{
	for (const TPair<FName, FTransform>& Bone : Pose.Local)
	{
		BoneSpaceTransforms[GetBoneIndex(Bone.Key)] = Bone.Value;
	}
}

TArray<FTransform> USupercutHands::GetComponentPose() const
{
	const FReferenceSkeleton& Skeleton = GetSkinnedAsset()->GetRefSkeleton();
	TArray<FTransform> Pose;
	Pose.SetNum(BoneSpaceTransforms.Num());
	for (int32 Bone = 0; Bone < Pose.Num(); ++Bone)   // a parent always comes before its children
	{
		const int32 Parent = Skeleton.GetParentIndex(Bone);
		Pose[Bone] = Parent == INDEX_NONE ? BoneSpaceTransforms[Bone] : BoneSpaceTransforms[Bone] * Pose[Parent];
	}
	return Pose;
}

IMPLEMENT_SIMPLE_AUTOMATION_TEST(FSupercutHandsFramesTest, "Supercut.Hands.PosesFromJsonMatchTheFilesFrames", HandsTestFlags)
bool FSupercutHandsFramesTest::RunTest(const FString& Parameters)
{
	// The FBX's frames 1 (grip + support), 2 (grip + board) and 3 (grip + clear), as Unreal's FBX importer reads them
	// (lane hands1's probe, SupercutHandsFrames.json), against the pose the component builds from the JSON at blend 0,
	// 1 and 0.5. Wrists and fingertips, component space, within 0.05 cm.
	const FString FixturePath = FPaths::Combine(FPaths::GameSourceDir(), TEXT("Supercut/SupercutHandsFrames.json"));
	const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Fixture = HandsReadJson(FixturePath);
	if (!TestTrue(FString::Printf(TEXT("%s is read"), *FixturePath), Fixture.IsValid()))
	{
		return false;
	}
	FHandsTestWorld World;
	if (!TestTrue(TEXT("test world"), World.Start()))
	{
		return false;
	}
	USupercutHands* Hands = MakeHands(World.SpawnHolder()->GetRootComponent());
	const FTransform Board = HandsLayoutBoardInHands();
	const TPair<const TCHAR*, float> Frames[] = { { TEXT("1"), 0.f }, { TEXT("2"), 1.f }, { TEXT("3"), 0.5f } };
	double Worst = 0.0;
	int32 Points = 0;
	for (const TPair<const TCHAR*, float>& Frame : Frames)
	{
		Hands->SetLeftBlend(Frame.Value, Board);
		Hands->RefreshBoneTransforms();
		for (const TPair<FString, TSharedPtr<FJsonValue>>& Want : Fixture->GetObjectField(TEXT("frames"))->GetObjectField(Frame.Key)->Values)
		{
			const FVector Got = HandsEngineBone(Hands, *Want.Key).GetLocation();
			const double Off = FVector::Dist(Got, HandsVector(Want.Value->AsArray()));
			Worst = FMath::Max(Worst, Off);
			++Points;
			AddInfo(FString::Printf(TEXT("HANDS frame %s %s: %.4f cm off"), Frame.Key, *Want.Key, Off));
			TestTrue(FString::Printf(TEXT("frame %s %s within %.2f cm (%.4f)"), Frame.Key, *Want.Key, HandsFrameToleranceCm, Off), Off <= HandsFrameToleranceCm);
		}
	}
	AddInfo(FString::Printf(TEXT("HANDS frames: %d points, worst %.4f cm"), Points, Worst));
	TestEqual(TEXT("12 points in each of the three frames"), Points, 36);
	return true;
}

#!/bin/bash
# farm.sh: build, test, package and run a SUPERCUT project copy on a farm PC, driven from c4. Details: ../FARM.md.
#
#   farm.sh mirror  <host> <name> <project folder on c4>     copy the project to <root>\Farm\<name> (changed files only)
#   farm.sh build   <host> <name> <log folder> [build.ps1 args, e.g. -Target Supercut -Jobs 8]
#   farm.sh test    <host> <name> <log folder> [run_tests.ps1 args, e.g. -Filter Supercut.Rooms]
#   farm.sh package <host> <name> <log folder>               Tools\package.cmd   -> <root>\Farm\_builds\<name>\Supercut59
#   farm.sh package-shipping <host> <name> <log folder>      Tools\package_shipping.cmd -> ...\_builds\<name>\Supercut59_ship
#   farm.sh run     <host> <name> <log folder> [run_demo.ps1 args]   {P} = the mirror folder there, e.g. -Script {P}\Script\main8.txt
#   farm.sh fetch   <host> <name> <remote path> <local folder>   path in the mirror, or builds/... or out/...
#   farm.sh status  <host>
#   farm.sh slots                                             who holds or waits for which PC right now
#
# Each step brings its logs back to <log folder>/<step>/ and exits with the remote step's exit code.
# Logs that come back have the PC's user and computer names replaced by USER and PC.
#
# Hosts: [pc-b], pc2, [pc-c], pc4 over ssh, and c4 itself (15 Nov: the owner freed c4 for lanes). On c4 nothing is
# copied: "mirror" makes D:\UE\Farm\<name> a junction to the project folder, so the steps build in that folder.
#
# Slots (15 Nov): build, test, package, package-shipping and run take one of the host's slots and wait for one
# when all are taken, so the lanes no longer pile onto one PC. A slot whose farm.sh has died is taken over.
set -u
here=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
root_of() {   # one line per farm PC: ssh alias, root folder there (engine in <root>\UE_5.9, mirrors in <root>\Farm)
  case "$1" in
    [pc-b]) echo 'C:\UE' ;;
    pc2)    echo 'C:\UE' ;;
    [pc-c])   echo 'F:\UE' ;;
    pc4)    echo 'C:\UE' ;;
    c4)     echo 'D:\UE' ;;
    *) echo "FARM unknown host '$1' ([pc-b], pc2, [pc-c], pc4, c4)" >&2; exit 64 ;;
  esac
}
slots_of() {  # heavy steps at once on each PC
  case "$1" in
    [pc-b]) echo 2 ;;
    pc2)    echo 1 ;;
    [pc-c])   echo 3 ;;
    c4)     echo 2 ;;
    *)      echo 1 ;;
  esac
}
fwd() { echo "${1//\\//}"; }   # C:\UE -> C:/UE for scp and tar
is_local() { [ "$1" = c4 ]; }
lockdir=/d/UE/Farm/_locks
slot=''
ubt=''

cd /d/UE/wt/hands2; python -I - <<'EOF'
L=["# Lane hands2: pictures of the owner's idle hold (Tuning.txt: SkeletalHands = 1) in room demo/gate.",
"# Run: -Room demo/gate -Seed 1 -Script '{P}\\Script\\hands2_owner.txt' -FixedFps 1200 -Silent -ResX 1920 -ResY 1080 (and -ResX 1440 for 4:3)",
"# 1200 fps so the clap's lift can be shot tick by tick: the left hand's way to the board moves 1/60 of the way per tick",
"# (ClapRiseSeconds 0.05), so tick k after the press is support to clear t = 2 SmoothStep(k/60): k 10 t 0.15, k 16 t 0.35,",
"# k 22 t 0.61. l<n>: the tick n-1 after the press (l00 is the tick before it). Then rest, the kick's peak and the reload",
"# every 100 ms, as in hands2_shots.txt.",
"0.05 key F4","0.10 look 0 0","0.60 shot h_rest","0.80 fire","0.81 shot h_kick","1.20 clap"]
for n in range(26):
    L.append("%.5f shot l%02d" % (1.20 + (n - 0.5) / 1200, n))
L.insert(len(L)-26, None)  # placeholder to keep clap before shots at same tick ordering check
L=[x for x in L if x is not None]
L+=["2.40 reload"]+["%.2f shot r%04d" % (2.40+i/10, i*100) for i in range(13)]+["3.80 end"]
# sort data lines by time, comments first
com=[x for x in L if x.startswith("#")]; dat=[x for x in L if not x.startswith("#")]
dat.sort(key=lambda x: float(x.split()[0]))
open("Script/hands2_owner.txt","w",newline="\r\n").write("\n".join(com+dat)+"\n")
print("\n".join(com+dat))
EOF

void AController::AddPawnTickDependency(APawn* NewPawn)
{
	if (NewPawn != NULL)
	{
		bool bNeedsPawnPrereq = true;
		UPawnMovementComponent* PawnMovement = NewPawn->GetMovementComponent();
		if (PawnMovement && PawnMovement->PrimaryComponentTick.bCanEverTick)
		{
			PawnMovement->PrimaryComponentTick.AddPrerequisite(this, this->PrimaryActorTick);

			// Don't need a prereq on the pawn if the movement component already sets up a prereq.
			if (PawnMovement->bTickBeforeOwner || NewPawn->PrimaryActorTick.GetPrerequisites().Contains(FTickPrerequisite(PawnMovement, PawnMovement->PrimaryComponentTick)))
			{
				bNeedsPawnPrereq = false;
			}
		}
		
		if (bNeedsPawnPrereq)
		{
			NewPawn->PrimaryActorTick.AddPrerequisite(this, this->PrimaryActorTick);
		}
void AController::SetPawn(APawn* InPawn)
{
	RemovePawnTickDependency(Pawn);

	SetPawn_Direct(InPawn);
	Character = (Pawn ? Cast<ACharacter>(Pawn) : NULL);

	AttachToPawn(Pawn);

	AddPawnTickDependency(Pawn);
}

 "content": "# Lane hands2: the owner's idle hold, pictures from two runs of Script/hands2_owner.txt (1920x1080 and 1440x1080),\n# each JPG at most 960 wide with its caption (what is wrong) in a band under it.\n#   python -I make_owner_shots.py <169 shots folder> <43 shots folder> <captions.json> <out folder>\n# The lift: the press and l00 run in the same tick, and the pawn ticks after its controller (Controller.cpp:495,\n# AddPawnTickDependency), so l<n> is n+1 ticks of 1/60 into the left hand's way: t = 2 SmoothStep((n+1)/60).\nimport json\nimport os\nimport sys\nimport textwrap\n\nfrom PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont\n\nWIDE, NARROW, CAPTIONS, OUT = sys.argv[1:5]\ncaptions = json.load(open(CAPTIONS, encoding=\"utf-8\"))\nfont = ImageFont.truetype(\"C:/Windows/Fonts/arial.ttf\", 16)\nsmall = ImageFont.truetype(\"C:/Windows/Fonts/arial.ttf\", 13)\nLIFT = [0, 9, 15, 21]\n\n\ndef t_of(n):\n    a = (n + 1) / 60.0\n    return 2 * (3 * a * a - 2 * a * a * a)\n\n\ndef load(folder, name):\n    return Image.open(os.path.join(folder, name + \".png\")).convert(\"RGB\")\n\n\ndef fit(image, width):\n    return image.resize((width, image.height * width // image.width), Image.LANCZOS)\n\n\ndef save(image, name):\n    lines = []\n    for paragraph in captions[name].split(\"\\n\"):\n        lines += textwrap.wrap(paragraph, 110) or [\"\"]\n    band = 10 + 20 * len(lines)\n    page = Image.new(\"RGB\", (image.width, image.height + band), (20, 20, 20))\n    page.paste(image, (0, 0))\n    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(page)\n    for row, line in enumerate(lines):\n        draw.text((8, image.height + 5 + 20 * row), line, fill=(235, 235, 235), font=font)\n    page.save(os.path.join(OUT, name + \".jpg\"), quality=88)\n\n\ndef grid(folder, names, labels, columns):\n    first = load(folder, names[0])\n    width = 960 // columns\n    height = first.height * width // first.width\n    rows = (len(names) + columns - 1) // columns\n    sheet = Image.new(\"RGB\", (960, rows * height), (0, 0, 0))\n    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)\n    for index, (name, label) in enumerate(zip(names, labels)):\n        x, y = (index % columns) * width, (index // columns) * height\n        sheet.paste(fit(load(folder, name), width), (x, y))\n        draw.rectangle((x, y, x + 8 + 7 * len(label), y + 17), fill=(0, 0, 0))\n        draw.text((x + 3, y + 2), label, fill=(255, 255, 0), font=small)\n    return sheet\n\n\nos.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)\nfor folder, aspect in ((WIDE, \"169\"), (NARROW, \"43\")):\n    save(fit(load(folder, \"h_rest\"), 960), \"owner_rest_\" + aspect)\n    save(fit(load(folder, \"h_kick\"), 960), \"owner_shot_\" + aspect)\n    save(grid(folder, [\"l%02d\" % n for n in LIFT], [\"t %.2f (l%02d)\" % (t_of(n), n) for n in LIFT], 2), \"owner_lift_\" + aspect)\n    reload = [\"r%04d\" % ms for ms in range(0, 1201, 100)]\n    save(grid(folder, reload, [\"%d ms\" % ms for ms in range(0, 1201, 100)], 4), \"owner_reload_\" + aspect)\nprint(\"made\", sorted(n for n in os.listdir(OUT) if n.startswith(\"owner_\")))\n"

Pick a name for your lane (letters, digits, no spaces): use your lane name, for example `vfx1`. Never use another
lane's name and never `proof` (the farm's own check).

```bash
F="[notes]/unreal/megajam-2026/farm/farm.sh"
LOGS=/d/UE/wt/vfx1_farmlogs          # any folder on c4 outside the worktree; each step writes LOGS/<step>/

"$F" status [pc-b]                                   # 1. load check, see "Before a heavy step" below
"$F" mirror [pc-b] vfx1 /d/UE/wt/vfx1                 # 2. copy your worktree (changed files only)
"$F" build  [pc-b] vfx1 "$LOGS" -Jobs 8               # 3. SupercutEditor, Development
"$F" test   [pc-b] vfx1 "$LOGS"                       # 4. all Supercut tests (or: -Filter Supercut.Rooms)
"$F" package [pc-b] vfx1 "$LOGS"                      # 5. Development package (compiles the game target itself)
"$F" run    [pc-b] vfx1 "$LOGS" -Packaged -Exe '{B}\Supercut59\Windows\Supercut.exe' \
            -Run main8 -Seed 1 -Script '{P}\Script\main8.txt' -FixedFps 240 -Silent      # 6. scripted run
grep "RUN wrapped" "$LOGS/run/run.log"                # 7. compare with the reference line
```

- Every step exits with the remote step's exit code and copies its logs to `$LOGS/<step>/` (old copy replaced).
  `build/ubt_SupercutEditor.log`, `test/tests.log`, `package/package_run.log`, `run/run.log` and `run/shots/*.png`.
  `console.txt` in each is what the Tools script printed, `farm_step.txt` the exit code and seconds.

904		/** Every distance along the ray (From, unit Dir) at which it crosses the surface. */
905		TArray<double> HandsRayHits(const FHandsSurface& Surface, const FVector& From, const FVector& Dir)
906		{
907			TArray<double> Hits;
908			for (int32 Tri = 0; Tri < Surface.A.Num(); ++Tri)
909			{
910				const FVector E1 = Surface.B[Tri] - Surface.A[Tri], E2 = Surface.C[Tri] - Surface.A[Tri];
911				const FVector P = FVector::CrossProduct(Dir, E2);
912				const double Det = FVector::DotProduct(E1, P);
913				if (FMath::Abs(Det) < 1e-12)
914				{
915					continue;
916				}
917				const FVector S = From - Surface.A[Tri];
918				const double U = FVector::DotProduct(S, P) / Det;
919				const FVector Q = FVector::CrossProduct(S, E1);
920				const double V = FVector::DotProduct(Dir, Q) / Det;
921				const double T = FVector::DotProduct(E2, Q) / Det;
922				if (U >= 0.0 && V >= 0.0 && U + V <= 1.0 && T > 0.0)
923				{
924					Hits.Add(T);
925				}
926			}
927			return Hits;
928		}

if (FirstPersonParams.bUseParameters)
	{
		// The projection matrix uses 1/tan(HalfFOV) on the X and Y components in view space, so in order to cancel out the existing FOV and achieve a different first person FOV, we do
		//		(1 / tan(HalfFirstPersonFOV)) / (1 / tan(HalfFOV)) 
		// which is equivalent to
		//		tan(HalfFOV) / tan(HalfFirstPersonFOV)
		// This correction factor should be independent of the actual aspect ratio used on the original projection matrix. As the FOV correction needs to be done in view space, we can conveniently
		// also use this opportunity to scale down the first person geometry towards the camera. The geometry takes up the same solid angle from the perspective of the camera and therefore appears the
		// same size while taking up a smaller range in the depth buffer, reducing the likelihood of intersections with the scene.
		const float FOVCorrectionFactor = FirstPersonParams.FOVCorrectionFactor;
		const FVector ScaleVector = FVector(FOVCorrectionFactor, FOVCorrectionFactor, 1.0f) * FirstPersonParams.Scale;
		WorldToFirstPerson = TranslatedViewMatrix * FScaleMatrix(ScaleVector) * InvTranslatedViewMatrix;
		FirstPersonToWorld = TranslatedViewMatrix * FScaleMatrix(ScaleVector.Reciprocal()) * InvTranslatedViewMatrix;
	}

{
 "file_path": "[notes]\\unreal\\megajam-2026\\lanes\\hands3\\tools\\make_shots.py",
 "content": "# Lane hands3: sheets from two runs of Script/hands3_shots.txt (1920x1080 and 1440x1080) with the switch on, and one\n# run's rest with the switch off, each JPG at most 960 wide, labels on the frames.\n#   python -I make_shots.py <on 169 shots> <on 43 shots> <off 169 shots> <off 43 shots> <out folder>\n# Lift: the press and l00 run in the same tick, and the pawn ticks after its controller (Controller.cpp:495), so l<n>\n# is n+1 ticks of 1/60 into the left hand's way: t = 2 SmoothStep((n+1)/60).\nimport os\nimport sys\n\nfrom PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont\n\nON169, ON43, OFF169, OFF43, OUT = sys.argv[1:6]\nsmall = ImageFont.truetype(\"C:/Windows/Fonts/arial.ttf\", 14)\nLIFT = [0, 9, 15, 21]\n\n\ndef t_of(n):\n    a = (n + 1) / 60.0\n    return 2 * (3 * a * a - 2 * a * a * a)\n\n\ndef load(folder, name):\n    return Image.open(os.path.join(folder, name + \".png\")).convert(\"RGB\")\n\n\ndef fit(image, width):\n    return image.resize((width, image.height * width // image.width), Image.LANCZOS)\n\n\ndef label(sheet, x, y, text):\n    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)\n    draw.rectangle((x, y, x + 10 + 7 * len(text), y + 19), fill=(0, 0, 0))\n    draw.text((x + 4, y + 2), text, fill=(255, 255, 0), font=small)\n\n\ndef grid(images, labels, columns):\n    width = 960 // columns\n    height = images[0].height * width // images[0].width\n    rows = (len(images) + columns - 1) // columns\n    sheet = Image.new(\"RGB\", (960, rows * height), (0, 0, 0))\n    for index, (image, text) in enumerate(zip(images, labels)):\n        x, y = (index % columns) * width, (index // columns) * height\n        sheet.paste(fit(image, width), (x, y))\n        label(sheet, x, y, text)\n    return sheet\n\n\ndef save(image, name):\n    image.save(os.path.join(OUT, name + \".jpg\"), quality=88)\n\n\nos.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)\nfor on, off, aspect in ((ON169, OFF169, \"169\"), (ON43, OFF43, \"43\")):\n    rest = fit(load(on, \"h_rest\"), 960)\n    label(rest, 0, 0, \"rest, switch on\")\n    save(rest, \"rest_\" + aspect)\n    kicks = [\"k%02d\" % n for n in range(16)]\n    save(grid([load(on, k) for k in kicks], [\"%s  %.0f ms\" % (k, 1000 * n / 60) for n, k in enumerate(kicks)], 4), \"kick_\" + aspect)\n    reload = [\"r%04d\" % ms for ms in range(0, 1201, 100)]\n    save(grid([load(on, r) for r in reload], [\"%d ms\" % ms for ms in range(0, 1201, 100)], 4), \"reload_\" + aspect)\n    lift = [\"l%02d\" % n for n in LIFT]\n    save(grid([load(on, l) for l in lift], [\"t %.2f (l%02d)\" % (t_of(n), n) for n, l in zip(LIFT, lift)], 2), \"lift_\" + aspect)\n    board = [\"b%04d\" % ms for ms in (80, 200, 350, 500, 620)]\n    save(grid([load(on, b) for b in board], [\"%d ms after the press\" % int(b[1:]) for b in board], 2), \"board_\" + aspect)\n    save(grid([load(off, \"h_rest\"), load(on, \"h_rest\")], [\"rest, switch off\", \"rest, switch on\"], 1), \"off_on_rest_\" + aspect)\nprint(\"made\", sorted(os.listdir(OUT)))\n"
}

def walk(n,path=""):
    name,props,kids=n; p=path+"/"+name
    yield p,name,props,kids
    for i,k in enumerate(kids): yield from walk(k,p+"#%d"%i)
def arrays(path):
    out={}
    objs=[n for n in read(path) if n[0]=='Objects'][0]
    for n_obj,obj in enumerate(objs[2]):
        label=obj[1][1].split(b'\x00')[0].decode(errors='replace') if len(obj[1])>1 else '?'
        for p,name,props,kids in walk(obj):
            for i,v in enumerate(props):
                if isinstance(v,np.ndarray): out[(obj[0],label+'@%d'%n_obj if obj[0]=='AnimationCurve' else label,p,i)]=v
            if name=='P' and len(props)>4 and isinstance(props[0],bytes) and props[0] in (b'Lcl Translation',b'Lcl Rotation',b'Lcl Scaling'):
                out[(obj[0],label,p+props[0].decode(),0)]=np.array(props[4:],dtype=float)
    return out
a=arrays(sys.argv[1]); b=arrays(sys.argv[2])
print("arrays",len(a),len(b),"only a",[k for k in a if k not in b][:5],"only b",[k for k in b if k not in a][:5])
worst=[]
for k in a:
    if k in b:
        x,y=a[k],b[k]
        if x.shape!=y.shape: print("SHAPE",k,x.shape,y.shape); continue
        dm=float(np.max(np.abs(x.astype(float)-y.astype(float)))) if x.size else 0.0
        worst.append((dm,k))

IMPLEMENT_SIMPLE_AUTOMATION_TEST(FSupercutHandsBoxHandTest, "Supercut.Hands.TheBoxHandIsNotDrawnWithTheSwitchOn", HandsTestFlags)
bool FSupercutHandsBoxHandTest::RunTest(const FString& Parameters)
{
	// 0.3 s into a clap the box hand (the two static meshes on the clap's root) is drawn with the switch off and not
	// with it on; the board is drawn in both (lane hands2).
	FHandsTuningRestore Restore;
	for (const int32 Switch : { 0, 1 })
	{
		FSupercutTuning::Get().SkeletalHands = Switch;
		FHandsRunWorld World;
		if (!TestTrue(TEXT("test world"), World.Start()))
		{
			return false;
		}
		ASupercutCharacter& Player = *World.Hero();
		for (int32 Tick = 0; Tick < 72; ++Tick)
		{
			World.Step();
		}
		TestTrue(TEXT("the clap freezes"), Player.Clap());
		for (int32 Tick = 0; Tick < 72; ++Tick)
		{
			World.Step();
		}
		const TArray<const UStaticMeshComponent*> Box = HandsBoxHand(Player);
		int32 Drawn = 0;
		for (const UStaticMeshComponent* Part : Box)
		{
			Drawn += Part->IsVisible() ? 1 : 0;
		}
		const bool bBoard = HandsNamedPart(Player, TEXT("ClapBoard"))->IsVisible();
		AddInfo(FString::Printf(TEXT("HANDS switch %d, %.3f s into the clap: %d of %d box hand parts drawn, board drawn %d"), Switch, Player.GetClapMotion().GetClock(), Drawn, Box.Num(), bBoard ? 1 : 0));
		TestEqual(TEXT("two box hand parts"), Box.Num(), 2);
		TestEqual(FString::Printf(TEXT("switch %d: box hand parts drawn"), Switch), Drawn, Switch == 0 ? 2 : 0);
		TestTrue(FString::Printf(TEXT("switch %d: the board is drawn"), Switch), bBoard);
	}
	return true;
}

#endif

});
		return Found;

	/**
	 * The hands' skin as posed now, skinned on the CPU from the imported model (linear blend, the engine's own sum),
	 * in component space. Side: each vertex goes with the hand of its heaviest bone ("_R" or "_L").
	 */
	struct FHandsSkin
	{
		TArray<FVector> Positions;
		TArray<bool> IsRight;
		TArray<uint32> Indices;
		int32 MostInfluences = 0;
	};

	FHandsSkin HandsSkin(const USupercutHands& Hands)
	{
		FHandsSkin Skin;
		const USkeletalMesh* Mesh = CastChecked<USkeletalMesh>(Hands.GetSkinnedAsset());
		const FReferenceSkeleton& Skeleton = Mesh->GetRefSkeleton();
		const TArray<FTransform> Posed = Hands.GetComponentPose();
		TArray<FTransform> Ref;
		Ref.SetNum(Skeleton.GetNum());
		for (int32 Bone = 0; Bone < Ref.Num(); ++Bone)
		{
			const int32 Parent = Skeleton.GetParentIndex(Bone);
			Ref[Bone] = Parent == INDEX_NONE ? Skeleton.GetRefBonePose()[Bone] : Skeleton.GetRefBonePose()[Bone] * Ref[Parent];
		}
		const FSkeletalMeshLODModel& Lod = Mesh->GetImportedModel()->LODModels[0];
		Skin.Indices = Lod.IndexBuffer;
		for (const FSkelMeshSection& Section : Lod.Sections)
		{
			for (const FSoftSkinVertex& Vertex : Section.SoftVertices)
			{
				FVector Sum = FVector::ZeroVector;
				double Total = 0.0, Heaviest = -1.0;
				int32 HeaviestBone = 0, Used = 0;
				for (int32 Slot = 0; Slot < MAX_TOTAL_INFLUENCES; ++Slot)
				{
					const double Weight = Vertex.InfluenceWeights[Slot];
					if (Weight <= 0.0)
					{
						continue;
					}
					const int32 Bone = Section.BoneMap[Vertex.InfluenceBones[Slot]];
					Sum += Weight * (Ref[Bone].Inverse() * Posed[Bone]).TransformPosition(FVector(Vertex.Position));
					Total += Weight;
					++Used;
					if (Weight > Heaviest)
					{
						Heaviest = Weight;
						HeaviestBone = Bone;
					}
				}
				Skin.Positions.Add(Sum / Total);
				const FString HeaviestName = Skeleton.GetBoneName(HeaviestBone).ToString();
				Skin.IsRight.Add(HeaviestName.EndsWith(TEXT("_R")) || HeaviestName.EndsWith(TEXT("_R_end")));
				Skin.MostInfluences = FMath::Max(Skin.MostInfluences, Used);
			}
		}
		return Skin;
	}

	FHandsSurface HandsRightSurface(const FHandsSkin& Skin)

void ASupercutCharacter::OnReloadBeat(FName Beat)
{
	// The hands lane keys its poses here. The empties fall from the open cylinder on the eject beat.
	UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Display, TEXT("RELOAD beat %s"), *Beat.ToString());
	if (Beat == TEXT("Eject"))
	{
		DropShells();
	}
	if (Beat == TEXT("Roll") || Beat == TEXT("Rise"))
	{
		bReloadHandBack = Beat == TEXT("Rise");   // the rigged left hand leaves on Roll and comes back on Rise (lane hands2)
	}
}

Moved, unchanged but for a bone name per vertex, to a new test-only header\n  `Source/Supercut/SupercutHandsSkin.h`, shared by the hands tests, Feel5 and GunParts.\n- In the frame only: each skin triangle is clipped to the frame's four sides, so a triangle whose corners are all off\n  the screen still counts by its part on the screen. Depth is linear on a triangle and distance from the eye convex,\n  so the clipped corners give its nearest depth and farthest reach exactly.\n- Near-plane crossing: on every triangle edge that runs across view depth near/HeldDepthScale, the crossing point,\n  and how many degrees outside the frame it is (the nearest one is reported, with its bone).\n- Feel5 and GunParts are now `WITH_DEV_AUTOMATION_TESTS && WITH_EDITOR`, like the hands tests: the imported model is\n  editor data. Tests run in the editor only, so nothing is skipped there.\n"
}

			const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject> Values = Bone.Value->AsObject();
			if (!Values.IsValid())
			{
				UE_LOG(LogSupercut, Fatal, TEXT("Hand pose data %s is not an object."), *Where);
			}
			Pose.Local.Add(FSupercutHandData::BoneName(Bone.Key), HandTransform(*Values, TEXT("t"), TEXT("q"), Where));
			Pose.Component.Add(FSupercutHandData::BoneName(Bone.Key), HandTransform(*Values, TEXT("ct"), TEXT("cq"), Where));
		}
		const TSharedPtr<FJsonObject>* Placement = nullptr;
		FString FixedTo;
		if (File->TryGetObjectField(TEXT("placement"), Placement) && File->TryGetStringField(TEXT("placement_fixed_to"), FixedTo) && FixedTo == TEXT("board_root"))
		{
			for (const TCHAR* Bone : { TEXT("hand.L"), TEXT("upper_arm.L") })
			{
				const FString Where = Name + TEXT(".json placement ") + Bone;
				Pose.OnBoard.Add(FSupercutHandData::BoneName(Bone), HandTransform(*HandObject(*HandObject(**Placement, Bone, Where), TEXT("rel_board_root"), Where), TEXT("t"), TEXT("q"), Where));
			}
		}
		return Pose;
	}
}

struct FSupercutTuning;
/** What the clap motion passed on one tick, for the character to act on. */
struct FSupercutClapEvents

	bool bSnap = false;      // the arm hit the slate: the clap sound, the view nod, the FOV punch, the sketch starts
	bool bJam = false;       // a refused clap stopped dead: clap_empty and the HUD's red shake

	bool bHandBack = false;  // the left hand is back at the gun (the grip_tap sound)

 * SweepHeldSeconds), breaks apart, and the hand leaves the frame. A press with no charges: the board rises, the arm

#!/bin/bash
# hands3: after the tests on [pc-c]: package, the switch-off runs, main8 with the switch on, then the pictures.
F="[notes]/unreal/megajam-2026/farm/farm.sh"; L=/d/UE/wt/hands3_farmlogs/x
T='F:\UE\Farm\hands3\Tuning.txt'
cd /d/UE/wt
tuning() { if [ "$1" = on ]; then ssh [pc-c] "powershell -NoProfile -Command \"Set-Content -Path '$T' -Value 'SkeletalHands = 1' -Encoding ascii; Get-Content '$T'\""; else ssh [pc-c] "powershell -NoProfile -Command \"Remove-Item '$T' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Test-Path '$T'\""; fi; }
run() { local k=$1; shift; "$F" run [pc-c] hands3 $L "$@" -TimeoutSeconds 540; rm -rf $L/run_$k; mv $L/run $L/run_$k; echo "$k $(date +%H:%M:%S)"; grep -h "RUN wrapped\|SCRIPT f\|SkeletalHands\|missing usage" $L/run_$k/*.log | sed 's/^\[[^]]*\]\[[^]]*\]//' | tail -4; }
if [ "$1" != nopackage ]; then
  "$F" package [pc-c] hands3 $L; cat $L/package/farm_step.txt
  echo "compile fails $(grep -c 'Failed to compile Material' $L/package/package_run.log) usage flags $(grep -c 'missing usage flag' $L/package/package_run.log)"
fi
tuning off
run main8_off1 -Run main8 -Seed 1 -Script '{P}\Script\main8.txt' -FixedFps 240 -Silent
run main8_off2 -Run main8 -Seed 1 -Script '{P}\Script\main8.txt' -FixedFps 240 -Silent
run s7_off -Seed 6 -Script '{P}\Script\gen\s7.txt' -FixedFps 60 -Silent
run off169 -Room demo/gate -Seed 1 -Dev -Script '{P}\Script\hands3_shots.txt' -FixedFps 1200 -Silent -ResX 1920 -ResY 1080
run off43 -Room demo/gate -Seed 1 -Dev -Script '{P}\Script\hands3_shots.txt' -FixedFps 1200 -Silent -ResX 1440 -ResY 1080
tuning on
run main8_on -Run main8 -Seed 1 -Script '{P}\Script\main8.txt' -FixedFps 240 -Silent
run on169 -Room demo/gate -Seed 1 -Dev -Script '{P}\Script\hands3_shots.txt' -FixedFps 1200 -Silent -ResX 1920 -ResY 1080
run on43 -Room demo/gate -Seed 1 -Dev -Script '{P}\Script\hands3_shots.txt' -FixedFps 1200 -Silent -ResX 1440 -ResY 1080
tuning off
echo "missing usage in runs: $(cat $L/run_*/*.log | grep -c 'missing usage flag')"
echo CHAINDONE

### Sun 15 Nov 19:12:33 · Agent (claude-opus-5-5)

hands4 is done and committed. The two failing tests were the hands' bounding box, not a real fault. The one real fault, the stray fingertips in the reload, is fixed in the hand blend.

**Measured numbers** (hands on, HeldDepthScale 0.388, every tick of draw, rest, a shot, the clap and a whole reload: 960 ticks)
- The hands are measured by the skin the eye sees: each skinned triangle is cut to the frame. That gives the same result in 16:9, 16:10 and 21:9 at the game's FOV. The engine keeps the vertical view angle (BaseEngine.ini:2902, CameraStackTypes.cpp:326-331), so all three shapes share one frame height.
- **Nearest skin in frame:** 16.75 cm deep (right thumb base, 35 ms after a shot), drawn at 6.50 cm. That is 4.10 cm more than the 2.0 + 0.4 cm needed.
- **Farthest skin in frame:** 57.76 cm (left hand leaving after the clap's break, 795 ms after the press), drawn at 22.41 cm. That is 11.59 cm inside the 34 cm capsule.
- **Forearms at the near plane:** the right forearm crosses it 37.6 degrees outside the frame. The crossing is never in frame in any of the three shapes.
- **Real fault or the box:** the old -39.2 cm and 102.5 cm were the forearms' box, behind the eye and out of frame.
- **The tests:** Feel5 and GunParts now assert all three rules in each shape instead of skipping the hands. They read the live pose, camera and board every tick, with no clap pose numbers written in, so the owner's new clap pose needs no test change.

**Stray fingertips**
- **Cause:** the left hand is out of frame at the clear pose and at the hidden board hold. Between the two, its index and middle fingertips came into the bottom edge from 80 to 115 ms, and again from 855 to 890 ms on the way back. In one reload the hand left the frame 3 times and came back 3 times.
- **Fix:** in a reload, that off-screen half of the move now happens in one tick. The hand leaves and comes back at the same moments as before. The clap is untouched.
- **Check:** a new test asserts the hand leaves once and comes back once in each shape, and it passes. The red came from the pass before the fix; I did not run a separate red pass.
- **Still there:** for about 25 ms as the hand leaves, the index tip is the last thing in frame. `[taste: owner review]`
